Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ManageUserCRUDService::modifyUser(userid: Integer,name: String,address: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: Set(BankCard) = BankCard.allInstance()->select(o|o.CardID = userid)
	precondition:
		obs.isEmpty() = bool and
		obs.size() = 1
	postcondition:
		let ob: BankCard in
		ob.oclIsNew() and
		obs->includes(ob) and
		ob.CardID = userid and
		ob.Name = name and
		ob.Address = address and
		result = true
}
